episodes.title: Reckless Ben vs Ideal Living: The $10M Cult Expose
episodes.description:
Did YouTuber Reckless Ben cross the legal line in his latest expose? Today, we analyze the serious legal risks Ben faces after accusing wellness company Ideal Living and CEO Peter Spiegel of functioning as a front to finance Jagadguru Kripalu Parishat (JKP)—a sect whose convicted leader fled child molestation charges.  
While investigative journalism is protected by the First Amendment, unverified criminal accusations create massive civil liability. If these explosive claims prove inaccurate, Ideal Living has grounds for major corporate lawsuits
